_comment: CFD prop-firm profile: trades CFDs via MetaTrader 5 across one or more prop-firm accounts. Forecast is generated ONCE for all accounts; per-account sizing uses each account's live balance/equity from MT5. Credentials are env-var NAMES only -- real values live in .env (gitignored).

connection._comment: IB TWS connection — only used when data.source='ib'. cfd_prop defaults to data.source='mt5' so the FTMO VPS does NOT need TWS installed. Kept here as a fallback in case the user wants to switch back to IB sourcing. port 7497=paper, 7496=live. client_id must be unique across all live scripts that share the same TWS instance.

data._comment_source: data.source='mt5' fetches daily OHLC via MetaTrader 5 (uses each ticker's instruments[*].mt5_symbol). data.source='ib' falls back to IB TWS (and requires the connection block above). For cfd_prop we default to 'mt5' so the FTMO VPS is fully self-contained (MT5 = data AND execution).
data._comment_use_cached_only: Emergency-only escape hatch: when true, skip data fetch entirely and just use whatever is already in the cache (bootstrapped from data/ohlc_data parquets). Useful if both TWS and MT5 are unavailable.
data._comment_lookback: Lookback windows. mt5_min_bars_per_ticker is the fail-fast threshold per required ticker; if MT5 returns fewer bars for any required ticker, the run aborts loudly (no silent fallback to stale cache).
data._comment_mt5_terminal_path: Optional explicit terminal path for the data fetch. If unset, falls back to the first enabled account's terminal_path.

mt5._comment_magic: Magic number ranges identify OUR orders so we never touch positions opened by other strategies/manual trades on the same account. Each account should have a unique magic_number; default_magic_number is used when an account omits it. Magic-number filtering is the ONLY isolation between our trades and other positions on the account.

accounts._comment: Example FTMO 100K demo account. Replace label, magic_number, and env var names per your setup. The env vars listed below must be set in your environment (or .env) before running with --execute. Per-account `max_daily_loss_pct` is supported and overrides the global execution default.
accounts.label: ftmo_100k_demo_a
accounts.terminal_path: C:/Program Files/FTMO Global Markets MT5 Terminal/terminal64.exe

execution._comment_approval: Default-on-timeout 'cancel' is the conservative choice. To enable 'no answer in 5 min = execute', set default_on_timeout to 'approve'. Even with 'approve', a Telegram/network outage detected during polling will still cancel (fail-closed).
execution._comment_authorized: authorized_telegram_user_ids is a whitelist of numeric Telegram user IDs allowed to approve/cancel. Leave empty + set allow_any_approver=false to fail-closed during initial setup. To find your user ID, DM @userinfobot in Telegram.
execution._comment_sizing: min_rebalance_lots is a hard floor in lots (never trade less). min_rebalance_notional_usd is a dead-band on the dollar value of the delta (skip noise). rebalance_mode: hybrid_close_on_flip is described in docs/library/live_forecast/cfd_prop_workflow.md.
execution._comment_safety: Remaining preflight gates (after stripping unnecessary filters). max_margin_usage_pct prevents margin-call risk by capping fraction of free margin we'll commit. max_daily_loss_pct defaults to 0.05 (5%) to match FTMO's daily-loss-limit; it only fires when an account also sets `sod_balance_env_var` so the orchestrator knows the start-of-day balance. Per-account `max_daily_loss_pct` overrides this default.
execution._comment_audit: Per-run JSON audit log directory (created if missing). Each run writes one file with plans + decisions + execution results for post-mortem analysis.
